_comment: @callumhoward/config-react — a pure add-on layer, not self-extending base, so consumers can compose several add-ons over one base: "extends": ["@callumhoward/config-base/tsconfig", "@callumhoward/config-react/tsconfig"]. If this layer re-extended base, a later add-on re-applying base would clobber this layer's lib/jsx overrides.
